minimality_boundary.route_not_universal: This is minimal only for the frozen component-resolved v+k3+k4 supervision route; it is not a universal source-identifiability theorem.
minimality_boundary.why_three_outputs: Within this sequential physical-state route, variance alone and variance plus k3 remain above 1e-8; k4 is needed, and collapsing the three labels to a free q scalar would no longer test physical-state supervision.

Preregister one rank-35 held sentinel, normalization, fixed epoch, source-zero replay, component alignment gates, resource bill, and one-shot claim before any target or cache access.
